description:
Per-extension-server integration of draft-ietf-jmap-metadata-02 helpers. Each opted-in extension-server MemoryBackend needs three integration points:

**1. query_objects filter matching (§3.5):** Wire the 6 metadata filter conditions (metadataExists, privateMetadataExists, metadataTextContains, privateMetadataTextContains, metadataTextEquals, privateMetadataTextEquals) into the MemoryBackend query_objects filter matcher. Metadata values live in the object's extras map under the 'metadata' and 'privateMetadata' keys. Use jmap_metadata_server::filter helpers.

**2. get_changes ignoreMetadataOnlyChanges (§2.4):** Honor the ignoreMetadataOnlyChanges request arg. When true, objects whose only changed properties are metadata/privateMetadata are excluded from the updated array. Use jmap_metadata_server::changes helpers (is_metadata_property, is_metadata_only_change).

**3. /set patch validation (§2.1, §2.3):** In create/update paths, validate metadata/privateMetadata patches — namespace validation (registered vs vendor per DataTypeMetadataInfo), depth limits (maxDepth). Use jmap_metadata_server::validate helpers (validate_depth, supports_namespace).

Canonical mail-server first (.1), then propagate to 6 siblings (.2-.7) per workspace canonical-template rule.

**Depends on:** JMAP-ua37.2 (jmap-metadata-server rewrite, already landed).
title: Wire metadata-02 helpers into extension-server MemoryBackends
